summary:
Implementation plan for FlameSense UI final touch upgrade:
1. Floating segmented menu bar with active badge counts (24 experiments, live status indicator, sleek organic curvature).
2. Revamped Overview into an interactive NASA Mission Status Console featuring a live microgravity combustion regime visualizer, interactive parameter scrubbers, and flight telemetry monitors.
3. Subtle micro-animations, quick telemetry tooltips, and responsive layout polish preserving zero-build vanilla ES module standards.
